title: Add-On Down-Payment Percentage for Patients in Good Standing with an Assistance Award
content:
Financial-assistance coordination standard: the percentage applied to an add-on down payment on a **Patient Payment Plans** plan, according to the patient's award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program and the plan's recent payment record.

## The rule

The percentage applied to an add-on down payment depends on the patient's standing:

- for a patient with an approved financial-assistance award of 50 percent or more and at least 6 scheduled installments paid less than 12 whole months before today, it is **5 percent**;
- for a patient with an approved award whose discount percentage is below 50 percent (a hardship adjustment included) and at least 6 scheduled installments paid in that span, it is **7.5 percent**;
- for any other patient, it is the plan term's down-payment percentage.

## Reading the records

- **Approved award and its discount percentage** — the patient's case under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved, and the discount percentage of the award on that case. An award under the Catastrophic Medical Hardship Adjustment is read with its own discount percentage; where that is below 50 percent, it falls in the second band.
- **Scheduled installments paid** — payments on the plan ledger posted as scheduled installments and dated less than 12 whole months before today.

## Percentage table

| Approved award | Award's discount percentage | Scheduled installments paid in the last 12 whole months | Percentage applied |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | 50 or more | 6 or more | 5 percent |
| Yes | below 50 | 6 or more | 7.5 percent |
| Yes | any | 5 or fewer | The term's down-payment percentage |
| No | — | any | The term's down-payment percentage |

## Hypothetical patients on a 12-Month Payment Plan (term percentage 10)

- Approved 75 percent award; 7 scheduled installments paid in the span: 5 percent.
- Approved 50 percent award; exactly 6 paid: 5 percent — 50 percent is "50 or more" and 6 is "at least 6".
- Approved 25 percent award; 9 paid: 7.5 percent.
- Approved 75 percent award; 5 paid: the term's 10 percent.
- No approved award; 11 paid: the term's 10 percent.
